confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Japanese regional-city prices, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with July demand and hotel category. Yen-based prices are converted at an assumed exchange rate of roughly 155 JPY per USD. FX: the RBA observation was taken from a search summary attributed to the RBA overview page and was not opened directly in this session, so verify it on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Japanese regional cities such as Okayama and Kanazawa. Accommodation is set below Kyoto-level pricing, with some uplift for Hiroshima's steady tourism from Peace Memorial and Miyajima visitors.
